title: Quickstart Slate — Reference App Collage and README Diagrams
creator: Ava Chen
description: Deliver a cohesive first-experience toolkit for the Template Apps family: a curated collage of reference-app screenshots and a set of versioned README diagrams (SVG + Markdown-ready PNGs) that explain the first-run flow, environment toggles, and the console quickstart. These assets will be embedded in the public docs quickstart and the repo README, and will be used by Growth for the feature launch banner. The goal is to make a single visual narrative that scales across docs, in-repo READMEs, and the onboarding modal in the Console.
deliverables: Reference App Collage: hero montage (1600x900), gallery tiles (640x360), and narrow banner (1200x360)
Annotated README Diagrams: three flow diagrams as editable Figma frames + exported SVG/PNG (sequence, environment toggles, troubleshooting)
Frame-level source files: Figma file with named pages, componentized symbols, and export presets
Export checklist: 1x, 2x, and 3x PNGs; optimized SVGs; accessible alt-text strings
Usage snippets: copy-ready Markdown embeds and img tags for docs and repo READMEs
acceptance_criteria: All screenshot sizes exported and pixel-perfect at the specified artboard sizes
Diagrams explain the 1) initial signup -> model selection, 2) local vs hosted toggle, 3) test run -> inspect tokens flow
Figma file contains clear layer names, an exports page, and a style token page for colors/typography
Assets include explicit alt-text and suggested caption copy for docs
Design reviewed and signed off by PM (Zara Gomez) and Eng owner (Mateo Alvarez) in comments
steps: Audit existing reference app screenshots across repos and pick canonical flows
Create initial collage exploration (3 variants: narrative-focus, product-focus, compact-banner)
Iterate on diagram drafts in Figma with PM/Eng feedback, produce annotated SVGs
Run export checklist, optimize files for docs (SVG minify, PNG compress), produce 2x/3x
Submit final asset ZIP + README snippet to docs repo and link in PR/Release notes
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: Chose a collage approach (multiple small frames) over a single hero screenshot to show both console and local dev views — improves comprehension for users who land in README vs Console
Use simplified iconography for README diagrams to reduce translation overhead in localized docs
Avoid heavy copy inside images; prefer captions underneath to keep images reusable for different contexts
